order.note: There is no progression to teach here and the guide teaches none. Copycats+ is a flat expansion of Create's own two copycat blocks - if the player has Create's copycat panel and step, every block in this mod is immediately meaningful. Order for quests should follow shape complexity, not tech tier: plain block, then slab/stairs/wall, then the exotic shapes.

gates.note: The only real prerequisite is understanding Create's copycat mechanic itself - you apply a material to the block and it keeps that material's properties. A quest line should teach the base Create copycat panel/step first; Copycats+ is meaningless before that.

signature.note: THE POINT OF THE MOD, and it is not decoration - it is inventory compression. The guide's closing argument is that a whole building that needed a full hotbar of logs, stairs, slabs, bricks, brick stairs, walls and their variants collapses into one base block plus four copycat shapes.

Standout item. The ghost block keeps the texture but has no hitbox, which players immediately use for hidden doors and secret bases. The guide devotes a whole segment to a hidden base built from these.
The bytes are the most-praised shape because multiple bytes stack inside a single block space, letting a player author a custom block face by face - the deepest expression of the mod.
The box takes a different material on every face; the guide calls out that it and the step are really stacks of separate parts sharing a block.

Layers stack like snow and can be placed vertically, giving arbitrary thickness; the half panel is a one-pixel panel versus Create's three-pixel one. Both are used heavily in the guide's wall-texturing demo.
Origin note worth carrying into quest text: the copycat family exists because of TRAINS - thin walls that do not eat carriage space. Decoration use came second.
